title: The Book of Philippians Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Philippians — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.decoded: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, write to all God’s holy people in Christ Jesus who live in Philippi, along with the church leaders and helpers.

verses.kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
verses.decoded: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.

verses.kjv: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
verses.decoded: I always pray for all of you with joy,

verses.kjv: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
verses.decoded: because you have shared in the work of the gospel with me from the very beginning until now.

verses.kjv: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
verses.decoded: I am sure that God, who started this good work in you, will continue it until the day when Jesus Christ returns.

verses.kjv: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
verses.decoded: I feel this way about all of you because I hold you in my heart. Whether I am in prison or defending and confirming the gospel, you all share in God’s grace with me.

verses.kjv: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: God can testify how deeply I care for all of you with the love of Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
verses.decoded: And this is my prayer: that your love will grow more and more, along with knowledge and good judgment.

verses.kjv: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
verses.decoded: So that you can recognize what is best and be pure and blameless until the day Christ returns.

verses.kjv: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
verses.decoded: Filled with the results of righteousness that come through Jesus Christ, bringing glory and praise to God.

verses.kjv: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that what has happened to me has actually helped spread the gospel.

verses.kjv: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
verses.decoded: Because of my imprisonment for Christ, my situation has become known throughout the palace and everywhere else.

verses.kjv: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.decoded: Many believers, encouraged by my imprisonment, are now more confident and boldly preach God’s word without fear.

verses.kjv: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
verses.decoded: Some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others do so with good intentions.

verses.kjv: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
verses.decoded: Those who preach Christ out of rivalry do it insincerely, hoping to make my imprisonment harder.

verses.kjv: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
verses.decoded: But the others preach out of love, knowing I am here to defend the gospel.

verses.kjv: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
verses.decoded: So what? Whether people preach Christ falsely or truly, Christ is still being preached. I rejoice in that and will continue to rejoice.

verses.kjv: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.decoded: I know that this will result in my deliverance, thanks to your prayers and the help from the Spirit of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
verses.decoded: I eagerly expect and hope that I will never be ashamed, but will boldly continue to honor Christ in my body, whether I live or die.

verses.kjv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.decoded: For me, living means serving Christ, and dying is even better.

verses.kjv: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
verses.decoded: But if I continue to live, I will produce fruit through my work, though I don’t know which I will choose.

verses.kjv: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
verses.decoded: I am torn between two desires: to depart this life and be with Christ, which is far better,

verses.kjv: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
verses.decoded: but it is more necessary for you that I remain alive.

verses.kjv: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
verses.decoded: So I am confident that I will stay with you and continue helping you grow and rejoice in your faith.

verses.kjv: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
verses.decoded: And your joy in Jesus Christ will be even greater when I come to you again.

verses.kjv: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
verses.decoded: Live your lives in a way that honors the gospel of Christ. Whether I visit you or am away, I want to hear that you are united in spirit and purpose, working together to defend the faith.

verses.kjv: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
verses.decoded: Don’t be afraid of those who oppose you. Their opposition shows they are doomed, but for you, it means salvation from God.

verses.kjv: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
verses.decoded: You have been given the privilege, not only to believe in Christ but also to suffer for him.

verses.kjv: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
verses.decoded: You are experiencing the same struggle you saw in me and now hear is still happening to me.

verses.kjv: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
verses.decoded: If you have any encouragement from being united with Christ, any comfort from his love, any fellowship with the Spirit, any tenderness and compassion,

verses.kjv: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
verses.decoded: then make me truly happy by being united in your thinking, loving one another, and working together with one purpose.

verses.kjv: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
verses.decoded: Don’t do anything out of selfish ambition or pride, but be humble, valuing others above yourselves.

verses.kjv: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
verses.decoded: Don’t just look out for your own interests, but also care about what others need.

verses.kjv: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
verses.decoded: Have the same attitude that Christ Jesus had.

verses.kjv: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
verses.decoded: Though he existed in the form of God, he did not consider equality with God something to cling to.

verses.kjv: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
verses.decoded: Instead, he gave up his divine privileges, took on the nature of a servant, and became human.

verses.kjv: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
verses.decoded: As a human, he humbled himself and obeyed God completely, even to the point of dying on a cross.

verses.kjv: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
verses.decoded: Because of this, God exalted him to the highest place and gave him a name above every other name.

verses.kjv: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
verses.decoded: So that at the name of Jesus every knee will bow—in heaven, on earth, and under the earth—

verses.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.decoded: and every tongue will confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, bringing glory to God the Father.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.decoded: Therefore, my dear friends, just as you have always obeyed me—not only when I was with you but now even more—continue to live out your salvation with reverence and seriousness.

verses.kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
verses.decoded: For God is the one who works in you, giving you the desire and the ability to do what pleases him.

verses.kjv: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
verses.decoded: Do everything without complaining or arguing.

verses.kjv: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
verses.decoded: Then you will be blameless and pure, children of God without fault, living among a crooked and sinful generation. You will shine like stars in the world.

verses.kjv: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
verses.decoded: Holding firmly to the word of life. Then I will be proud that I did not run or work for nothing.

verses.kjv: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
verses.decoded: Even if I am poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.

verses.kjv: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
verses.decoded: And you should be glad and rejoice with me for the same reason.

verses.kjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
verses.decoded: I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, so I can be encouraged by hearing how you are doing.

verses.kjv: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
verses.decoded: I have no one else like Timothy who genuinely cares about your well-being.

verses.kjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.
verses.decoded: Everyone looks out for themselves, not for what Jesus Christ wants.

verses.kjv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
verses.decoded: But you know Timothy’s proven character; like a son with his father, he has served with me in spreading the gospel.

verses.kjv: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
verses.decoded: So I plan to send him to you soon, as soon as I know how things will turn out for me.

verses.kjv: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
verses.decoded: But I trust the Lord that I myself will come to you soon.

verses.kjv: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
verses.decoded: Meanwhile, I thought it was necessary to send Epaphroditus to you. He is my brother, co-worker, and fellow soldier. He is your messenger and has taken care of my needs.

verses.kjv: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
verses.decoded: He has been longing to see all of you and was very worried because you heard he had been ill.

verses.kjv: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.decoded: He was really sick and close to death, but God had mercy on him—and on me too—so I wouldn’t have more sadness.

verses.kjv: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.decoded: So I sent him with even more care, so when you see him again, you will be glad, and I will have less sadness.

verses.kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
verses.decoded: So welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor people like him.

verses.kjv: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
verses.decoded: Because he risked his life for the work of Christ, not worrying about his own safety, to make up for what you couldn’t do for me.

verses.kjv: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
verses.decoded: Finally, my brothers and sisters, always be joyful in the Lord. Writing these same things to you is not a burden for me, but it is helpful for you.

verses.kjv: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
verses.decoded: Watch out for those who do evil, those who cause trouble, and those who insist on circumcision for salvation.

verses.kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
verses.decoded: We are the true people of God, worshiping by the Spirit of God, proud of Christ Jesus, and not trusting in our own efforts.

verses.kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
verses.decoded: Even if I could trust in my own efforts, I have more reasons to do so than anyone else.

verses.kjv: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
verses.decoded: I was circumcised on the eighth day, born an Israelite from the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews, and as far as the law goes, a Pharisee.

verses.kjv: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
verses.decoded: I was zealous in persecuting the church and was blameless in obeying the law.

verses.kjv: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
verses.decoded: But whatever was a gain to me, I now consider a loss because of Christ.

verses.kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
verses.decoded: Yes, I am sure of it—I consider everything worthless compared to the greatness of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For his sake, I have lost everything and consider it garbage, so I can gain Christ.

verses.kjv: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
verses.decoded: I want to be found in him, not having my own righteousness based on the law, but the righteousness that comes through faith in Christ—a righteousness from God based on faith.

verses.kjv: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
verses.decoded: I want to know Christ and the power of his resurrection, and to share in his sufferings, becoming like him in his death.

verses.kjv: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
verses.decoded: I want to experience the resurrection from the dead in any way possible.

verses.kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: I don’t claim to have already reached this goal or to be perfect. But I keep trying to catch up to what Christ Jesus has called me to.

verses.kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, I don’t consider myself to have reached the goal. But one thing I do: I forget what is behind and reach forward to what lies ahead.

verses.kjv: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: I keep striving toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly call in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
verses.decoded: So, as many as are mature, let’s think this way. And if you think differently about anything, God will make it clear to you.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
verses.decoded: But let’s keep living by the same standard we have already reached and focus on the same goal.

verses.kjv: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, follow my example, and watch those who live according to the pattern you have seen in us.

verses.kjv: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
verses.decoded: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ, and I have warned you about them often, even with tears.

verses.kjv: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
verses.decoded: Their destiny is destruction. Their god is their appetite, and they take pride in shameful things. They think only about earthly matters.

verses.kjv: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.decoded: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await the Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
verses.decoded: He will transform our lowly bodies to be like his glorious body, by the power that enables him to bring everything under his control.

verses.kjv: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
verses.decoded: Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, whom I love and long to see—my joy and crown—stand firm in the Lord, my beloved friends.

verses.kjv: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.decoded: I urge Euodia and I urge Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.

verses.kjv: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.decoded: And I ask you, my true partner, to help these women who worked with me in spreading the gospel, along with Clement and the other coworkers whose names are recorded in the book of life.

verses.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
verses.decoded: Always be joyful in the Lord. I will say it again: Be joyful.

verses.kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.decoded: Let everyone see that you are gentle and reasonable. The Lord is near.

verses.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.decoded: Don’t worry about anything. Instead, pray and ask God for everything you need, always giving thanks.

verses.kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: Then God’s peace, which is beyond human understanding, will guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
verses.decoded: Finally, brothers and sisters, think about things that are true, honorable, right, pure, lovely, and admirable. If anything is excellent or worthy of praise, focus your thoughts on those things.

verses.kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
verses.decoded: Put into practice what you have learned, received, heard, and seen in me. Then the God of peace will be with you.

verses.kjv: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
verses.decoded: I was very happy in the Lord that you have once again shown concern for me. You cared before, but didn’t have the chance to help.

verses.kjv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
verses.decoded: I’m not saying this because I’m in need, for I have learned to be content no matter what my situation is.

verses.kjv: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
verses.decoded: I know how to live humbly and how to live with plenty. In any situation, I have learned to be satisfied or hungry, to have plenty or to be in need.

verses.kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.decoded: I can do everything through Christ who gives me strength.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
verses.decoded: Still, you have done well by sharing in my troubles.

verses.kjv: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
verses.decoded: You Philippians know that when I first preached the gospel and left Macedonia, no church helped me financially except you.

verses.kjv: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
verses.decoded: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you sent help more than once when I needed it.

verses.kjv: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
verses.decoded: I’m not seeking a gift, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from your generosity.

verses.kjv: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
verses.decoded: I have everything I need and more. I am satisfied because Epaphroditus brought me your gifts, which are like a fragrant offering, pleasing to God.

verses.kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
verses.decoded: Greet every believer in Christ Jesus. The brothers and sisters with me send their greetings.

verses.kjv: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Cæsar’s household.
verses.decoded: All God’s people send their greetings, especially those who belong to Caesar’s household.

verses.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.decoded: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you. Amen.
